Exploration graph: Plan, track and prove work in the exploration graph: intents, facts, hints, goals and constraints. Claim intents so parallel agents do not collide, poll for changes since a cursor, and journal changes made to targets.
Assets and scope: Insert and query assets, manage company and task scope, and record coverage.
Findings: Report, list, merge, dismiss and bind findings to captured traffic.
Credentials: Store and list credentials discovered during an engagement.
Evidence: Save, list and retrieve proof-of-concept evidence, or capture command output as evidence.
Enrichment and ingestion: DNS and HTTP enrichment, and importing nmap, nuclei, httpx, ffuf and masscan output.
Engagement management: Create, switch, update, close and delete engagements, inspect their status, activity and coverage gaps, and list connected sessions.
Activity: Read and write the engagement activity log.
Reporting and export: Generate the Markdown report and move engagements between servers.
Traffic: Search, inspect, replay and export traffic captured by the recording proxy.
